رُمُقٌ , a pl., signifying Poor men, who are satisfied with little sustenance, such as suffices to stay, or arrest, the remains of life, or to maintain the strength: ―
-b2- and envying persons: sing. ↓ رَامِقٌ and ↓ رَمُوقٌ : (IAar, K, TA:) which signifies one. who looks at men from the outer angle of the eye and with envy. (IAar, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
